allow: PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/studio" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 20; "STUDIO STATUS: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; "LENGTH: $\($r.Content.Length\)" } catch { "STUDIO ERROR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)"; if \($_.Exception.Response\) { "HTTP STATUS: $\([int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode\)" } })

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 20; "HOME STATUS: $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { "HOME ERROR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)"; if \($_.Exception.Response\) { "HTTP STATUS: $\([int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode\)" } })

PowerShell(try { $h=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 60; "HOME STATUS: $\($h.StatusCode\)"; $count=\([regex]::Matches\($h.Content,'Absolute Returns'\)\).Count; "ABSOLUTE-RETURNS OCCURRENCES ON HOME: $count" } catch { "ERROR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })
